quickAnswerTitle: Quick Answer: Does Untuckit Run Small and Solve Shirt Proportions?
quickAnswer: Untuckit shirts generally fit true to size in their Regular Fit, but their Slim Fit cut runs slightly small and snug through the chest and shoulders. If you are between sizes or have an athletic build, size up in Slim Fit or choose the Regular Fit. In terms of length, Untuckit shirts measure approximately 28.5 to 29.5 inches (roughly 2 to 3 inches shorter than traditional 31–33 inch dress shirts), engineered to fall precisely at mid-zipper to eliminate the untucked 'nightgown' look without tailoring.
intro: Tucking in your shirt has long been a requirement of traditional menswear. Yet in weekend settings, beachside venues, and modern creative offices, keeping a shirt tucked can feel overly formal and restrictive. The problem? Taking a standard dress shirt and leaving it untucked invariably results in excess fabric that swallows your legs and makes you appear shorter. Untuckit built a global brand around solving this exact proportional problem. In this Untuckit shirts sizing and fit review, we examine whether they run small, exact hem length measurements, fabric durability, and how to style untucked shirts effortlessly.

sections.heading: 1. How Long Are Untuckit Shirts? The Mid-Zipper Measurement
paragraphs: The golden rule of wearing an untucked shirt states that the bottom curved hem must fall halfway down your trouser zipper—leaving the front trouser pockets accessible while fully covering your belt line.

How long are Untuckit shirts in actual measurements? A standard Medium Untuckit shirt features a center back length of approximately 28.5 to 29.5 inches. Compare that to a conventional dress shirt, which typically measures 31 to 33 inches to remain tucked into trousers.

By trimming those crucial 2 to 3 inches off the bottom and redesigning the side sweep curves, Untuckit shirts hit the exact mid-fly proportional mark on 90% of men without requiring custom tailoring alterations.

sections.heading: 2. Do Untuckit Shirts Run Small? Sizing Breakdown
paragraphs: One of the most common questions before buying is: do Untuckit shirts run small? The answer depends directly on which fit profile you select:

Untuckit Regular Fit fits true to size with a comfortable, classic drape through the chest and abdomen. If you normally wear a Medium in standard mall brands like J.Crew or Banana Republic, an Untuckit Medium Regular will fit comfortably.

However, Untuckit Slim Fit cut runs slightly small and trim. It features higher armholes, a narrowed chest box, and an aggressive taper toward the waist. If you have broad shoulders, an athletic chest, or prefer extra breathing room, we recommend sizing up by one size when choosing the Slim Fit cut.

bullets.label: Regular Fit
bullets.text: True to size. Offers 2 extra inches across the chest and waist for average-to-broader builds.

bullets.label: Slim Fit
bullets.text: Runs slightly small/snug. Form-fitting across chest and lats with zero lower-back ballooning.

bullets.label: Relaxed Fit
bullets.text: Generous cut with straight side seams designed for fuller torsos and maximum ease.

sections.heading: 3. Torso Length Options: Regular vs. Tall vs. Short Torso
paragraphs: Untuckit provides dedicated torso length cuts so the hem line never sits too high or too low relative to your height:
Standard length fits men between 5'8 and 6'2. If you fall outside this height bracket, selecting the proper specialty cut is critical for maintaining correct proportions.

bullets.label: Short Torso Cut
bullets.text: Designed for men under 5'8. Reduces hem length by 1.5 inches and shortens sleeve lengths proportionally.

bullets.label: Tall Cut
bullets.text: Designed for men 6'2 and taller. Adds 2 inches to sleeve lengths and 1.5 inches to the bottom hem.

sections.heading: 4. Fabric Quality & Wrinkle Resistance
paragraphs: Untuckit uses 100% two-ply cotton across their flagship wrinkle-free collections. The fabric possesses substantial body that resists creasing even after hours of sitting in flights or driving.
For summer, their washed linen and cotton-linen blends provide excellent airflow while retaining enough collar structure to prevent the lapels from folding flat.

sections.heading: 5. How to Pair Untucked Shirts with Chinos and Pants
paragraphs: Because an untucked shirt creates an inherently casual silhouette, it pairs naturally with tapered flat-front chinos, dark wash denim, and clean leather sneakers.

Pair a dark navy Untuckit button-down with classic tan chinos for smart casual outings. Review our complete styling guide on [what color shirt goes with khaki pants](/blog/what-color-shirt-goes-with-khaki-pants) to master contrast ratios, or test different color combinations using our [interactive color wheel tool](/color-matcher).

sections.heading: 6. Untuckit Shirts Review Verdict: Are They Worth It?
paragraphs: If you routinely spend $20 to $30 at the tailor shortening the hem and sleeve lengths of conventional dress shirts, Untuckit saves both time and alteration costs. The curved hem is engineered specifically to look intentional untucked, avoiding the boxy flat-bottom hem found on vintage camp shirts.

While priced at a premium ($88 to $118), their wrinkle-free cotton weaves, reinforced collars, and multi-fit sizing options make them a versatile wardrobe workhorse for men who dislike tucking in their shirts.

faqs.question: Do Untuckit shirts run small?
faqs.answer: Untuckit Regular Fit shirts fit true to size. However, the Slim Fit cut runs slightly small and snug across the chest, shoulders, and upper back. If you have an athletic build, broad lats, or fall between sizes, size up by one size in Slim Fit or choose your standard size in Regular Fit.

faqs.question: How long are Untuckit shirts?
faqs.answer: A standard Medium Untuckit shirt measures approximately 28.5 to 29.5 inches in total center-back length. This is 2 to 3 inches shorter than standard dress shirts (which measure 31 to 33 inches), allowing the hem to rest perfectly halfway down your trouser zipper fly.

faqs.question: Can you tuck in an Untuckit shirt if needed?
faqs.answer: Technically yes, but because the hem is shortened to hit mid-fly, the shirt tails may pull out of your trouser waistband whenever you raise your arms or bend over. They are designed exclusively to be worn untucked.

faqs.question: Are Untuckit shirts good quality and worth the price?
faqs.answer: Yes. Untuckit shirts feature two-ply 100% cotton, durable button stitching, structured collar interlinings, and effective wrinkle-free treatments that justify the $88–$118 price point for men who want a tailored untucked fit right off the rack.

faqs.question: What pants look best with Untuckit shirts?
faqs.answer: Untuckit shirts look best with slim or straight-fit chinos, tailored 5-pocket pants, and dark selvedge denim. Pair with clean leather loafers, suede chukkas, or low-top white sneakers.
